questions.question: What is the legal nature of ANAM under Law 65-00?
options: A public establishment with legal personality
A private limited company under full private supervision
A department attached to the Ministry of Finance
A non-profit association of practitioners
questions.explanation: ANAM is a public establishment, guaranteeing its administrative independence.

questions.question: How are national agreements governed?
options: By an agreement between managers and providers
By a unilateral decision of the central State
By a private contract signed between two dentists
By an annual vote of patients in the regions
questions.explanation: The national agreement frames the relationships between the parties.

questions.question: What is an AMO managing body?
options: A public institution responsible for collection
A private structure for insurance management
An approved pharmacy for medication sales
An independent dental practice in rural areas
questions.explanation: The managing body (CNSS/CNOPS) provides benefit services.

questions.question: What is the coverage limit for care?
options: It is defined by nomenclatures of procedures
It is set by the practitioner's free choice
It depends on the total annual contribution amount
It is decreed by medical associations
questions.explanation: The nomenclature sets the reference tariffs for procedures.

questions.question: Exemption from the ticket modérateur is possible for:
options: Listed serious or chronic conditions
All procedures performed by the dentist
Patients seeking aesthetic comfort
All services in the private liberal sector
questions.explanation: Exemption specifically targets ALD (Long-Term Conditions).

questions.question: How is risk managed in the event of a third-party accident?
options: The managing body exercises legal recourse
The patient must bear all costs
The dentist bears the total financial loss
The law prohibits any claim for reimbursement
questions.explanation: The law allows recourse against the responsible third party.

questions.question: The permanent commission is a body for:
options: Regulation within the ANAM council
Internal accounting management of clinics
Verification of practitioners' diplomas
Setting the salaries of nursing assistants
questions.explanation: The commission ensures the regulation of the system.

questions.question: What are the obligations of a contracted dentist?
options: Apply the tariffs set by the agreement
Provide all emergency procedures free of charge
Transmit files to the Ministry of Finance
Offer discounts based on the patient's status
questions.explanation: Compliance with agreed tariffs is an obligation.

questions.question: Is AMO registration mandatory?
options: Yes, for any person exercising an activity
No, it remains optional depending on the contract
Yes, only for the royal public sector
No, except in cases of confirmed serious illness
questions.explanation: The obligation to register is the foundation of AMO.

questions.question: What does the law provide for flow control?
options: An integrated management information system
A paper declaration sent by mail
A manual verification by ANAM agents
An annual random sampling control
questions.explanation: The law promotes digitalization and computerization.

questions.question: Do dental benefits include imaging?
options: Yes, if necessary for diagnosis of care
No, only surgical procedures are included
Yes, only for patients under 10 years old
No, imaging is always outside the scope
questions.explanation: Technical procedures include radiological examinations.

questions.question: How is the AMO reserve fund financed?
options: By a portion of insured members' contributions
By direct taxes on private practices
By fines paid by pharmacists
By voluntary donations from private mutuals
questions.explanation: Contributions feed the technical reserves.

questions.question: What is the penalty for making a false declaration?
options: Criminal prosecution is incurred
A simple warning by the body
A temporary reduction in reimbursements
Forced transfer to another body
questions.explanation: The law provides for penalties against fraud.

questions.question: Does health insurance cover care abroad?
options: No, except in the case of a specific bilateral agreement
Yes, for all services provided
No, the law prohibits reimbursement outside the country
Yes, only for urgent dental care
questions.explanation: Territoriality is the principle, except for exceptions.

questions.question: Is the shared medical record governed by law?
options: Yes, it ensures continuity of care and flows
No, the file remains the property of the patient
Yes, only for radiological data
No, the law does not mention this digital tool
questions.explanation: The law encourages data interoperability.

questions.question: What is the role of the CNSS Board of Directors?
options: Supervise the management of AMO funds
Define dental care techniques
Verify instrument sterilization
Accredit private dental practices
questions.explanation: Financial management is under its responsibility.

questions.question: Are preventive procedures encouraged?
options: Yes, because they reduce care costs
No, the law focuses only on curative care
Yes, only for rural populations
No, prevention is at the patient's expense
questions.explanation: Prevention is a major focus of Law 65-00.

questions.question: Who verifies the conformity of care provided?
options: The medical service of the managing body
The council of the Order of Dental Surgeons
The tax department in the commune
The association of patients in the region
questions.explanation: The medical service validates the adequacy of care/procedures.

questions.question: Can AMO reimburse medications?
options: Yes, according to a list of approved medications
No, medications are fully at the patient's expense
Yes, all medications without exception
No, only for hospitalized patients
questions.explanation: The law provides a limited list (generics).

questions.question: What is the prescription period for invoices?
options: Set by the regulations in force
Freely chosen by each dentist
Only two years after the procedure
Imposed by the Ministry of Public Health
questions.explanation: The deadline is strictly regulated.

questions.question: Is the status of dependents protected?
options: Yes, by maintaining guaranteed rights
No, coverage ceases upon death
Yes, only for minor children
No, only the main insured person is covered
questions.explanation: The law protects the insured person's family.

questions.question: Can ANAM impose sanctions?
options: Yes, in case of breach of agreements
No, it has no disciplinary power
Yes, it can revoke dentists
No, it must go through the ministry
questions.explanation: ANAM regulates and can sanction abuses.

questions.question: Are tariffs revisable under the law?
options: Yes, during agreement renegotiation
No, tariffs are fixed and definitive
Yes, by unilateral decision of the dentist
No, except during periods of economic crisis
questions.explanation: Periodic revision is provided for by agreement.

questions.question: What does national pricing mean?
options: The base tariff for reimbursement
The free tariff chosen by the practitioner
The maximum tariff allowed in emergencies
The reduced tariff for low-income patients
questions.explanation: National pricing serves as the AMO reference.

questions.question: Is informing the patient a rule?
options: Yes, the patient must know the tariffs
No, the secret is kept by the doctor
Yes, only by the AMO manager
No, this is not stipulated by law
questions.explanation: Transparency of tariffs is mandatory.
